description: Astronova Cosmic Explorer is an interactive space mission platform built for NASA Space Apps. Designed for Artemis and Mars missions, it features an HD Solar System Explorer, a Star Catalog, and sixteen live browser tools—including light-delay, weight calculators, orbital velocity, mission elapsed time, and radiation estimators. Complete with ARIA, an offline AI assistant, it delivers zero-API-key mission planning and astrophysics insights directly in your browser.
